mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.user_id AS userId, l.login_start_time AS loginStartTime, l.login_end_time AS loginEndTime, l.duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, l.login_ip AS loginIp, l.user_agent AS userAgent, l.last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, l.logout_reason AS logoutReason, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM login_record l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.user_id = u.id WHERE (u.username IS NULL OR LOWER(u.username) <> 'system') ORDER BY l.login_start_time DESC, l.id DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, login_start_time AS loginStartTime, login_end_time AS loginEndTime, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, login_ip AS loginIp, user_agent AS userAgent, last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, logout_reason AS logoutReason, created_at AS createdAt FROM login_record WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT l.id, l.user_id AS userId, l.login_start_time AS loginStartTime, l.login_end_time AS loginEndTime, l.duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, l.login_ip AS loginIp, l.user_agent AS userAgent, l.last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, l.logout_reason AS logoutReason, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM login_record l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.user_id = u.id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND (u.username IS NULL OR LOWER(u.username) <> 'system') ORDER BY l.login_start_time DESC, l.id DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, login_start_time AS loginStartTime, login_end_time AS loginEndTime, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, login_ip AS loginIp, user_agent AS userAgent, last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, logout_reason AS logoutReason, created_at AS createdAt FROM login_record WHERE login_end_time IS NULL AND last_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND last_seen_at <= #{cutoffTime}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_record ( user_id, login_start_time, duration_seconds, login_ip, user_agent, last_seen_at, logout_reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{loginStartTime}, #{durationSeconds}, #{loginIp}, #{userAgent}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{logoutReason}, #{createdAt} )
